note: Lawrence County AL publishes no zoning district service: its Mapping & Appraisal page links none, and its KCS GIS parcel services (Lawrence/Public, Lawrence_Hwy/Public) have parcels, flood zones and annotation but no zoning layer. The City of Moulton adopts its zoning map only as a PDF inside Ordinance 2013-004, with no queryable service found on its site. No other city or town in the county (Courtland, Hillsboro) was found publishing zoning as a service.
